title: Suryodaya: completed activities dated "today" are refused as future between 00:00 and 05:30 IST — the date rule uses the UTC date, not the company's day (MEDIUM)
description:
Suryodaya: completed activities dated "today" are refused as future between 00:00 and 05:30 IST — the date rule uses the UTC date, not the company's day (MEDIUM)

What happened: 2026-10-17 04:25:44 IST (2026-10-16 22:55:44 UTC), POST /api/Activity
{type: call, party_id: 0617f889-…, due_date: "2026-10-17", done: true}
→ 422 {"field":"due_date","message":"A completed activity cannot be dated in the future"}.
Controls in the same second: done=true dated 2026-10-16 → 201; done=false dated 2026-10-17 → 201.
The created rows carry created_at 2026-10-16T22:55:47 (UTC), i.e. the server's "today" was 10-16.
Boundary: the identical call at 05:29:42 IST (23:59:42 UTC) → 422; at 05:30:22 IST (00:00:22 UTC)
→ 201. The cut-over is exactly UTC midnight.

Expected: "today" for a company in India is the IST date. A call finished at 04:25 IST on
17 Oct is dated 17 Oct and is not in the future.

Impact: every Suryodaya user (UTC+5:30) for the first 5½ hours of each day cannot log work
completed that day; the only workaround is to back-date it, which corrupts last-contact
history (deals look a day staler, rot scores shift). An agent logging follow-ups in an early run
gets 422s on correct input. Mirror on Keystone (UTC−4/−5): from 20:00 EDT a completed call dated
tomorrow is accepted (verified 2026-10-16 00:13 UTC, 20:13 EDT), giving a future last contact that
hides rot. Neither company record has a timezone field, so the rule cannot use the company day.

Reproduce: log in to Suryodaya between 00:00 and 05:30 IST; POST /api/Activity with done=true and
due_date = today's IST date → 422. Same call after 05:30 IST → 201.

Scope checked: REST, Activity create, Suryodaya (this report) and Keystone (mirror, accepted-future
side). MCP and update path not tested. Script: pipeline_agent/bugs/h4_su_probe.sh.

Related: 529f67e0 (su, B8: a done Activity dated in the future) and 80aa56f5 (ks, 09-28: due_date /
done+future rules) — the done+future rule added since, which fixes those, is what misfires here.

Fixtures: [team07-test BH-20261013] Party 0617f889; Activities 95c8d929, 70cbe2dc, 7c23a5b0, all closed as cancelled tasks.
